home.title: Ke Aupuni O Ke Akua - The Kingdom of God
home.body_md:
## Welcome to Ke Aupuni O Ke Akua - The Kingdom of God

Mahalo for visiting. This site is dedicated to rediscovering the revolutionary Kingdom message that Jesus actually preached, which is often missed in modern religious traditions.

### Our Mission: Kingdom, Not Religion
Jesus's central focus was the Kingdom of God—the reign and rule of God breaking into the human experience here and now. Our resources aim to guide you into a deeper understanding of Kingdom principles, citizenship, and authority, moving you from religious performance into authentic, transformative living.

**Start your journey today by exploring 'The Call to Repentance' series in the navigation.**

### What Jesus Actually Taught

**Kingdom Principles Over Religious Rules** - Discover how Jesus consistently chose kingdom living over religious compliance.

**Repentance as Transformation** - Move beyond feeling sorry for sins to understanding a complete transformation of mind, heart, and lifestyle.

**Heaven on Earth** - Learn how the Kingdom of God is meant to manifest in our daily lives, relationships, and communities right now.

aloha_wellness.title: Aloha Wellness - Island Health & Healing
aloha_wellness.body_md:
## Aloha Wellness - The Sacred Art of How You Eat

Discover the life-changing power of **how** you eat, not just what you eat. This groundbreaking wellness book combines cutting-edge scientific research with ancient Hawaiian mana'o (wisdom) to transform your relationship with food and nourishment.

### Beyond Diet Culture - A Hawaiian Perspective

Traditional Hawaiian culture understood something modern society has forgotten: eating is a sacred act that connects us to the land, our ancestors, and our own spiritual well-being. This book bridges that ancient wisdom with contemporary nutritional science.

### Revolutionary Approach: How, Not What

**Mindful Consumption** - Learn the scientific basis for how mindful eating practices affect digestion, metabolism, and overall health.

**Cultural Eating Wisdom** - Discover how Hawaiian ancestors approached meals as community ceremonies, gratitude practices, and spiritual connections.

**Stress and Digestion** - Research-backed insights into how your emotional state during meals affects nutrient absorption and digestive health.

**Rhythm and Timing** - Ancient Hawaiian understanding of eating in harmony with natural rhythms, supported by modern chronobiology research.

### Hawaiian Mana'o (Wisdom Principles)

**Ho'oponopono with Food** - Making right relationships with nourishment and healing food-related guilt or shame.

**Aloha 'Āina** - Love of the land extends to gratitude for the food it provides and mindful consumption practices.

**Lōkahi** - Finding unity and balance in your relationship with food, body, and spirit.

**Mālama** - Caring for your body as a sacred temple through conscious eating practices.

Transform your health from the inside out by changing not what you eat, but how you approach the sacred act of nourishment.

call_to_repentance.title: The Call to Repentance - The Kingdom Series
call_to_repentance.body_md:
## The Call to Repentance - Rediscovering Jesus's Kingdom Message

Step beyond religious tradition and rediscover the revolutionary Kingdom message that Jesus actually preached. This transformative book series cuts through centuries of religious interpretation to reveal the pure, life-changing teachings of the Kingdom of God.

### Series Overview (Volumes 1-5)

This isn't a single book but a comprehensive series that systematically unpacks Jesus's kingdom teachings.

---

### **Volume 1: The Foundation**
![The Call to Repentance Volume 1 Cover](https://via.placeholder.com/300x450/4A90E2/FFFFFF?text=Volume+1)
Understanding what the Kingdom of God actually is and why Jesus made it His central message.

---

### **Volume 2: Kingdom Citizenship**
![The Call to Repentance Volume 2 Cover](https://via.placeholder.com/300x450/50C878/FFFFFF?text=Volume+2)
What it means to be a citizen of God's kingdom while living in earthly systems.

---

### **Volume 3: Kingdom Economics**
![The Call to Repentance Volume 3 Cover](https://via.placeholder.com/300x450/FFB347/FFFFFF?text=Volume+3)
How kingdom principles transform our relationship with money, work, and provision.

---

### **Volume 4: Kingdom Relationships**
![The Call to Repentance Volume 4 Cover](https://via.placeholder.com/300x450/FF6B6B/FFFFFF?text=Volume+4)
Love, forgiveness, and community the way Jesus intended.

---

### **Volume 5: Kingdom Authority**
![The Call to Repentance Volume 5 Cover](https://via.placeholder.com/300x450/9B59B6/FFFFFF?text=Volume+5)
Walking in the supernatural power that Jesus demonstrated and promised to His followers.

---

*"Repent, for the kingdom of heaven has come near." - Matthew 4:17*

nahenahe_voice.title: The Nahenahe Voice of Nahono'opi'ilani - Musical Legacy
nahenahe_voice.body_md:
## The Nahenahe Voice of Nahono'opi'ilani - Live from Molokai Ranch Lodge

Experience the soul-stirring sounds of authentic Hawaiian music captured live at the historic Molokai Ranch Lodge in the year 2000. This intimate recording showcases the true meaning of **nahenahe** - the gentle, soothing voice that carries the spirit of aloha across the islands.

### A Sacred Musical Journey

Recorded in the peaceful setting of Molokai Ranch Lodge, this collection features solo guitar and traditional Hawaiian melodies that speak directly to the heart.

**Nahenahe** means more than just "soft" or "sweet" - it represents music that heals, soothes, and connects us to the divine presence that flows through all creation.

*"Music is the language that speaks when words are not enough. The nahenahe voice carries aloha to every heart that listens."*
